[SWS_CM_00709] FIFO semantics
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00206
⌈
The Communication Management shall provide buffering with FIFO semantics be-
tween sender and receiver of events.
⌋
Note:
The Implementation of such a FIFO buffer (i.e. whether to be in Kernel Space,
Shared Memory Space or IPC-Daemon Space) was not further detailed on purpose.
